context: Ongoing: Vent path sizing and cell spacing to contain a single-cell runaway. This week: Farah wants 3 mm and a mica sheet; Lukas says that costs 18 mm of pack length.
Ongoing: FOC rewrite with a thermal model and derating for DVT actuators
Ongoing: Tendons fray at the proximal pulley after 40k grip cycles
Ongoing: Type III anodize adds ~0.025 mm per surface and kills the bearing press fit. This week: Arjun okays reaming four parts by hand to keep the build moving; rest reordered.
Ongoing: Harness conductors breaking at the knee after ~15k flex cycles. This week: Callum proposes routing inboard through the joint axis; Diego says thigh link needs rework.
Ongoing: Gait controller tuning for the investor demo on the gait gantry. This week: Ankle gains cut 30%; Lin flags the boom clamp slipping on the pelvis adapter.
Ongoing: Too many life tests for one grip fixture and one dyno. This week: Ingrid says no until DVT; run pinch tests on nights instead.
Ongoing: Whether to machine pelvis plates from 7075 or wait for a casting. This week: Plates released; static load test planned on the drop gantry with a load yoke.
